title: VFO - Verbier Festival Orchestra
about: The Verbier Festival Orchestra is recruiting musicians for summer 2027. Live-audition applications close 14 December 2026 and video-audition applications close 11 January 2027 (both 23:59 EST).
card_alt: EduCut Connect card for VFO - Verbier Festival Orchestra at the Verbier Festival, Verbier, Switzerland, live-audition deadline 14 Dec 2026. The photo shows Zermatt and the Matterhorn with a Swiss flag, not Verbier.
